diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because no rollouts passed any content checks, meaning the model was unable to correctly identify the necessary decisions even when it attempted to assign roles. However, there is no evidence of a structural leak because all content check tallies are zero; the model simply failed to reach the specific values required by the hidden facts (PF1, PF2, PF3) using only the shared information.
